title: Why Long Chats Make AI Worse

lines.tts: The longer you chat with AI, the dumber it gets. And no, it's not your imagination.
lines.text: The longer you chat with AI, the dumber it gets. And no, it's not your imagination.

lines.tts: Every time you send a message, the AI re-reads the entire conversation from the top. Every single time.
lines.text: Every time you send a message, the AI re-reads the entire conversation from the top. Every single time.

lines.tts: And it can only hold so much at once. That's called the context window.
lines.text: And it can only hold so much at once. That's called the context window.

lines.tts: When a chat gets huge, the stuff in the middle goes blurry, and your old instructions get buried.
lines.text: When a chat gets huge, the stuff in the middle goes blurry, and your old instructions get buried.

lines.tts: You see, it's like a waiter taking orders for a giant table with no notepad. By order twenty, table one is getting the wrong pizza.
lines.text: You see, it's like a waiter taking orders for a giant table with no notepad. By order twenty, table one is getting the wrong pizza.

lines.tts: So here's the fix. When a chat gets long, ask for a short summary, open a fresh chat, and paste it in.
lines.text: So here's the fix. When a chat gets long, ask for a short summary, open a fresh chat, and paste it in.

lines.tts: Same brain. Clean desk. Way better answers.
lines.text: Same brain. Clean desk. Way better answers.

lines.tts: Your AI isn't tired. It's just drowning in your old messages.
